'''Polyresin''' was an adhesive that could be used to seal [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] breaches.<ref name="Goroth">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Polyresin was introduced in ''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook written by [[Nigel D. Findley]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Goroth" />
